notes: Drafting tasks. Each query mirrors what a model following guide://compose would send. expect = tags every result should carry (register or style). Edit freely; bump version when queries change so baselines are not compared across versions.

tasks.brief: A short love letter to a long-term partner who is away for a month. Warm, specific, not cheesy.

queries.query: miss you every morning
the house is quiet without you
counting the days until you come home
queries.like: I think about you every morning

tasks.brief: A thank-you note to a neighbour who looked after my dog while I was in hospital.

queries.query: thank you for your kindness
I do not know how to repay you
looked after him while I was ill

tasks.brief: A condolence card to a colleague whose father died after a long illness.

queries.query: sorry for your loss
he will be deeply missed
thinking of you and your family

tasks.brief: A two-minute toast for a best friend's 40th birthday party.

queries.query: raise a glass to an old friend
the years have been kind to you
here is to many more years

tasks.brief: Best-man wedding speech: how the couple met, what marriage means, closing toast.

queries.query: the day they first met
love is patient
may your life together be happy

tasks.brief: An apology to a sibling for missing their graduation.

queries.query: I am so sorry I was not there
I let you down
I hope you can forgive me

tasks.brief: Cover letter opening and closing for a museum education role. Professional, sincere.

queries.query: I am writing to apply for the position
passion for teaching children about history
I look forward to hearing from you

tasks.brief: A retirement card for a mentor after 35 years at the same school.

queries.query: you have earned your rest
you taught me more than you know
enjoy the years ahead

tasks.brief: A eulogy for a grandmother who loved gardening and fed everyone who visited.

queries.query: she loved her garden
her kitchen was always full
death is not the end

tasks.brief: A card congratulating friends on the birth of their first child.

queries.query: welcome to the world little one
your lives will never be the same
a child is a gift

tasks.brief: A paragraph describing an autumn walk by a river at dusk, for a personal essay.

queries.query: leaves falling on the river at dusk
the light fading over the water
cold air smelled of smoke

tasks.brief: A note encouraging a friend who just failed their bar exam to try again.

queries.query: do not give up
failure is not the end
I believe in you
